title: The stage is set: trophy unveiled ahead of the upcoming tournament
excerpt: Groundstaff put the final touches to the venue as the silverware goes on show before the opening match.
body: The trophy was put on display at the venue on Tuesday evening as groundstaff rolled the pitch for the final time before the opening fixture.
Teams arrive later this week for training sessions, with the first match set under lights. Organisers expect a full house for the opener.
quote: Every team here believes this can be their year.
author: Sports Desk
